milestone.name: P4 release assurance
milestone.objective: Validate and merge the personalized-content, user-personalization, and LinkedIn guidance work without weakening existing production gates.

lastCompletedWork.summary: Added reusable user personalization and current-project personalized-content skills, strengthened accessible whiteboard and handcrafted-diorama behavior, and aligned LinkedIn drafts with a profile-aware short-form best-practices baseline.

decisions.decision: Keep reusable personalization in one validated local profile owned by user-personalization.
decisions.rationale: A Git-ignored profile supplies approved identity, voice, perspective, visual, and safety preferences without embedding one person's data in shipped skill contracts.

decisions.decision: Bind personalized-content runs to a fresh understanding of the current repository and unique repository-local output directories.
decisions.rationale: Fresh source digests and immutable run directories prevent stale or externally substituted project narratives.

decisions.decision: Require a qualified bitmap or physically based 3D renderer for finished diorama PNGs.
decisions.rationale: Specification and alt-text fallback is more honest than presenting a flat browser composition as a handcrafted photographic diorama.

decisions.decision: Apply a sanitized LinkedIn short-form baseline on top of validated profile preferences.
decisions.rationale: Posts now enforce one topic, a why-care opening, readable bullets, a discussion action, a 3,000-character ceiling, three to five final hashtags, and media/public-context readiness without shipping private program links.

decisions.decision: Keep generated visual runs and the locally modified demo PowerPoint out of this commit.
decisions.rationale: The commit should contain reusable framework behavior and evidence; local derivative artifacts and an unrelated binary change remain available on the source workstation.

Supported local checks passed, but this workstation has no standalone npm and cannot execute the mandatory package and release-candidate gate. Existing trusted-signing and independent-review blockers also remain.

validation.evidence: A clean staged snapshot passed six User Personalization and Personalized Content tests plus eight relevant contract, generated-help, identity, profile-closure, dependency, and acyclic-graph tests: 14 passed and zero failed.

The managed Code.exe runtime cannot reliably execute unrelated tests that recursively spawn process.execPath, and the source workstation intentionally retains a modified demo PowerPoint outside the staged boundary. Run the complete npm gate on the personal laptop.
reports/security-check.json records 234 commit-scoped files scanned, zero package dependencies, and no findings.
All 47 skills passed inventory audit; generated help exposed the LinkedIn readiness rules; framework verification passed; Project Understanding completed and the project guide validated against it.
reports/change-review.json records no findings for the approved framework-only boundary and keeps npm run check as a merge-blocking validation gap.
The npm executable is unavailable on this managed workstation, so package creation, offline installation, and fresh release-candidate verification could not run.

worktree.attribution: The approved commit contains reusable skills, schemas, tests, configuration, documentation, handoff, review, and generated evidence. Local visual artifacts and the modified demo PowerPoint are intentionally excluded.

blockers: The mandatory npm run check, package-install test, release build, and fresh release-candidate verification require a workstation with standalone Node.js and npm.
AUD-0205 production release assurance remains unresolved.
Trusted signing and distinct independent-review identities are absent.
No restricted internal artifact destination, installation-health signal, or tested revocation operation exists.
Required human source review awaits a second qualified collaborator.
Azure Government publication readiness remains blocked wherever current service, channel, authorization, or data-boundary availability is unknown.
pendingApprovals: The user authorized one normal commit and push to origin/feat/agent-builder-latest for this bounded framework-only change set; that authorization is consumed by this handoff operation.
Any later commit, push, force push, pull request mutation, or merge performed by an agent requires new explicit approval.
Trusted signing, independent review, release, publication, deployment, hosted-agent changes, MCP installation, and Azure mutation remain separately gated.
limitations: The ignored .skills-orchestrator/user-personalization.json remains local and is not included in the commit.
No qualified image generator or physically based 3D renderer was available; the compliant final diorama run contains specification and alt text only.
Generated visual artifacts and the locally modified Demo/Project-Orchestrator-Demo.pptx remain uncommitted on the source workstation.

VS Code's bundled Node runtime is suitable for focused checks but not the complete suite because recursive process.execPath calls resolve to Code.exe; use standalone Node.js and npm for the final gate.
The Microsoft Copilot Studio VS Code extension was not installed because the managed AllowedExtensions policy omits ms-copilotstudio.vscode-copilotstudio.
The current release candidate predates these source changes and cannot establish release readiness.

nextAction.action: Pull origin/feat/agent-builder-latest on the personal laptop, verify a supported Node.js and npm toolchain, run npm run check, inspect hosted checks and the final branch diff, then merge only if every required gate passes.
prerequisites: Use Node.js 22, 24, or 26 with npm 11.11.0 or a repository-compatible exact npm version.
Do not treat the prior release candidate as current; npm run check must rebuild and verify it from this commit.
Preserve P4 production blockers after merge unless separate evidence resolves them.
